beschreibung:
Symbiosis of Protective Structure and Cultural Venue

The Alpinarium Galtür is a structure unique in the world. Built after the devastating avalanche disaster of 1999, the museum is integrated directly into the rear of the village's massive avalanche protection wall, standing as a symbol of safety and remembrance.

The Exhibition GANZ OBEN

This modern experiential exhibition sheds light on life in extreme high-alpine environments. Visitors learn fascinating facts about natural hazards, glacier melt, alpine culture, and the historic interaction between mountain farmers and their harsh environment.
